name: zmk-layer-hud
author: Rafael Romão
description: Shows or hides the ZMK layer HUD; it keeps counting while hidden

barWidget.description: A click shows or hides the HUD, or starts it when it is not running

schema.label: Command
schema.description: The zmk-layer-hud command (empty: ~/.local/bin/zmk-layer-hud). `zmk-layer-hud menubar enable` fills it in.

schema.label: State directory
schema.description: Where the running HUD says whether it is shown (empty: $XDG_STATE_HOME/zmk-layer-hud).

schema.label: Start with
schema.description: What a start runs through, so the HUD outlives a shell restart (uwsm-app --).
